mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch — depositAndCall gated to FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS; onCrossChainCall target side no access control
reentrancy / callback — IZRC20.deposit(target,amount) before zContract(target).onCrossChainCall; target receives tokens first then callback
wrong-value — amount forwarded to onCrossChainCall is raw param, not what deposit credited (fee/partial mint)
missing invariant enforcement — no validation zrc20 is a registered ZRC20
external-call failure / DoS — onCrossChainCall revert blocks cross-chain deposits
hook-timing mismatch (CEI violation) — tokens land in target before callback completes

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: CEI violation + reentrancy: IZRC20(zrc20).deposit(target, amount) transfers tokens to target BEFORE zContract(target).onCrossChainCall(...). Target holds live tokens during its own callback; if target re-enters any function relying on its token balance/ZRC20 state, it can act on inflated balances before tx finalizes.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Attacker deploys malicious zContract at target; cross-chain deposit routed to it; during onCrossChainCall, target re-enters (withdraw/swap/further cross-chain) using already-deposited tokens. Targets are user-deployed on ZetaChain.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Deploy malicious zContract T. 2. cross-chain deposit targets T. 3. depositAndCall(context,zrc20,amount,T,message). 4. deposit(T,amount) credits T. 5. onCrossChainCall(T) — T holds tokens. 6. T re-enters ZRC20 (withdraw/transfer) using fresh balance. 7. T drains/double-spends.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Cross-chain depositor / protocol; ZRC20 supply accounting inconsistent.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: deposit() precedes onCrossChainCall() with no reentrancy guard/lock/CEI separation; target external user-controlled. Classic reentrancy with fund-loss potential.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: Stale amount forwarded: amount passed to onCrossChainCall is the raw param, not the actual credited amount from deposit(). If ZRC20 deposit applies a fee/burn/tax, the target's logic operates on a larger amount than credited.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Any cross-chain call where ZRC20 has deposit-side fees/rebasing; passive — target relies on amount for accounting.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. deposit() applies fee: credited=amount-fee. 2. onCrossChainCall gets full amount. 3. target records amount as deposit. 4. user credited more than received — protocol insolvent by fee delta.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol / other users (records more credit than tokens held).
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Depositing user credited for more than deposited.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: deposit() return value not captured; amount passed is raw param. Different state variable (target ledger) and actor path than reentrancy.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Missing ZRC20 address validation — no registry/whitelist check
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: depositAndCall accepts zrc20 as calldata with no registry lookup in visible source.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS is truly trusted/immutable and whether registry check is enforced at protocol layer before EVM call.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: line: if (msg.sender != FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS) revert CallerIsNotFungibleModule(); FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS is a hardcoded constant.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Unprivileged caller reverts at first line.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: both dangerous self-referential targets explicitly rejected with InvalidTarget.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Deposited ZRC20 drained via reentrancy during onCrossChainCall; or inflated accounting credit when deposit fees cause mismatch.
impact_direction.attacker_preserves: Cross-chain deposit completes from external chain's view; attacker retains extracted value.
impact_direction.victim_loses: Cross-chain depositor loses tokens (reentrancy); protocol/users lose accounting integrity (stale-amount).
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain value correctness: tokens deposited must equal tokens target is informed of AND must be secured before target callback.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Reentrancy requires no privileged setup beyond user-deployed target; stale-amount triggered by any fee-bearing ZRC20; neither dust/admin/timing/self-funded.

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: reentrancy (CEI) + stale-amount carried; ZRC20 registry unresolved
